name: i.safe MOBILE IS910.1
statusNote: i.safe MOBILE has moved it to the archive of its range.
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS910.1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) 8-inch Android tablet from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx. It runs Android 8. It has been discontinued; the i.safe MOBILE IS930.1 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db IP6X
atex.status: IECEx Current (not withdrawn), issue 0, checked 2026-10-25. Product discontinued.

certification.northAmerica: NEC 500: Class I Div 1 Groups A, B, C, D T4; Class II Div 1 Groups E, F, G; Class III Div 1

safety.conditions: IECEx X conditions: battery charged outside Ex areas only; protect from high-energy impacts, UV and high electrostatic charge; ambient −20 °C to +60 °C.
